description: Anonymous MiG-23MF installed outside the Carver Aviation office at Baramati airport in Jan 2008; no serial visible in any photograph, undercarriage bays exposed (warbirds.in). Flying-school premises; access by arrangement.

Bell 47G-2 built Jan 1957, ex-IAF trainer sold to Helicopter Services Juhu, later Indamer/Agricultural Aviation crop sprayer and film helicopter; restored to ground-running condition by Shrikant Kotnis and shown at Aero India 2007 as "Ageless Beauty"; owned by Pushpaka Aviation and kept at Carver Aviation Baramati as of a Nov 2014 appeal (warbirds.in). Whether it has since returned to Pushpaka at Juhu is unknown - needs check.
